answer: Prayers & Duties >> Waqf, Mosque, Madrasa Question ID: 155753 Country: india Title: Masajid donation Question: A charitable trust started collecting the donation for a masjid to be built at a particular location, but now the masjid is not being built at that place so some people want their money back because the masjid is not being built at original place for which they donated the money. Do people have right to take their money back and does the trust have to give their money back? Please reply soon. Answer ID: 155753 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 210/183/B=2/1439) That money has yet not been waqf (endowed) for the mosque hence the money can be returned to those who want their money back. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
